headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk assessment into ClearInstall to provide up-to-date security and compliance checks, ensuring users are aware of potential vulnerabilities before installation. Leverage AI-driven analysis for faster and more accurate risk evaluations.
actions: Implement a real-time API that fetches the latest vulnerability data from public repositories like npm and PyPI directly within the ClearInstall tool.
Integrate an AI model to analyze dependency tree structures and predict potential security risks, offering proactive advice on safer alternatives or mitigation
Develop a feature that automatically updates lockfiles with known vulnerabilities and suggests patches or alternative packages based on severity.
